def join_results(mine: str, theirs: str) -> str:
    """Join two read results with "|"."""
    ex join_results("a", "b") == "a|b"
    ex join_results("", "") == "|"
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Read path and notes/../secret.txt through fs and join the results with "|".
    Failed reads contribute "". Intended to be called with a confined fs."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs narrowed to the notes directory, so path is relative to notes."""
    pre not path.startswith("/")
    post out.endswith("|")
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
